question: What are the supported unit special upgrades, how are they stored and granted, and where does each effect enter gameplay or presentation?

scope.boundary: This packet maps the complete nine-item identity and storage set, the normal grant route, and currently proved direct effects. It remains open until direct consumers for every situational effect and the presentation and persistence boundaries are exact.

dependencies.use: Provides the accepted unit-table shape, movement units, and presentation boundary.
Provides the accepted displayed-to-internal movement conversion used by March.
Provides command type 22 dispatch into the normal promotion writer.
Provides the accepted combat owner and situational predicate boundary.
Separates the rank byte and creation-time Veteran grant from special upgrades.

identities.name: Blitz
identities.description: Post-attack movement allowance; the accepted consumer adds three internal units.
identities.result: After an action, the consumer requires bit zero, requires unit lifecycle bit 0x400 to be clear, then sets lifecycle bit 0x400 and adds three internal units to movement byte +0x02.

identities.name: Infiltration
identities.description: City-attack strength adjustment: 50 percent; the direct consumer remains unresolved.

identities.name: Guerilla
identities.description: +50% attack under the native territory predicate
identities.result: For bit two, helper 0x82CFC0A8 looks up defender coordinates in territory table 0x830E8790 and compares the result against attacker record +0x00. The proved effect is attack-only (+50%).
identities.qualification: The comparison is static evidence only. The semantic meaning of attacker record +0x00 and the territory-table ownership relation remain unresolved, so this does not establish a home or enemy-territory interpretation or runtime behavior.

identities.name: Engineer
identities.description: City-dependent defensive strength adjustment: 100 percent; the direct consumer remains unresolved.

identities.name: Leadership
identities.description: Stack-dependent defensive strength adjustment: 100 percent; the direct consumer remains unresolved.

identities.name: March
identities.description: Movement allowance adjustment: one displayed point, or three internal units at grant.
identities.result: The normal writer adds three internal movement units to runtime unit byte +0x02 when it grants index six.

identities.name: Medic
identities.description: Healing beyond friendly territory is the described effect; the direct consumer remains unresolved.
identities.qualification: The bounded unit-record scan found no consumer that both loads +0x10 and masks 0x80. A nearby 0x80 test belongs to unit-definition flags and is not Medic.

identities.name: Scout
identities.description: The text concerns city-defense information and one extra visibility point; downstream effects remain unresolved.
identities.result: The consumer masks unit +0x10 with 0x100 and selects mode 2 for 0x82D076D8 when Scout is present. The normal writer also calls 0x82D11AD8(1, 1) after granting Scout.
identities.qualification: The exact mode selection and immediate rebuild are proved. The downstream city-defense-stat rendering and +1 view effect remain unresolved.

storage.encoding: Bits zero through eight follow the supported-image string order.
storage.rankSeparation: Runtime unit signed byte +0x05 stores rank. Veteran and Elite are rank states and are not bits in this word.
storage.movementSeparation: Runtime unit byte +0x02 stores current movement budget. March updates both its special-upgrade bit and this separate budget at grant time.

normalGrant.result: The command consumer ORs 1 shifted by the selected index into unit +0x10 and subtracts one from rank byte +0x05.

specialCases.result: Adds three to current movement byte +0x02.

eligibility.result: Requires rank greater than two, rejects six or more set bits in the 32-bit +0x10 word, and rejects unit definitions whose flag word intersects mask 0x6.

aiSelection.result: Checks eligibility, enumerates indices zero through eight, skips existing bits, scores candidates, and submits command type 22.

combatConsumerSearch.result: No bit-specific consumer for masks 0x2, 0x8, 0x10, or 0x20 was found in the dispatcher, combat resolver, effective attack or defense accessors, eligibility helper, or upgrade counter. Guerilla mask 0x4 has the separate static consumer at 0x82CFC0A8. 0x82CD7A60 tests +0x10 only as a whole-word nonzero gate and is a separate dispatcher path from combat resolver 0x82CD9970.
combatConsumerSearch.qualification: This bounded negative result rules out the inspected direct paths for those four combat bits. It does not prove those effects are absent. The separate loyaltyDefenseBoundary now identifies index3 in a derived helper, without reopening or contradicting this direct-reader negative; the other selected effects remain unresolved.

loyaltyDefenseBoundary.status: proved selected branch; conditional retained combat path
loyaltyDefenseBoundary.unit: Entry r3=p,r4=j selects U=0x830F2BF0+0x54*(256*p+j); r5 is presentation mode. Owner byte U+0 and signed halfword coordinates U+0x1C/+0x1E are the ordinary creator fields.
loyaltyDefenseBoundary.selection: The0..8 bit loop reads U+0x10 at0x82CFBF48. Its idx-3 switch at0x82CFBF58..7C maps index3 through U32[0x82CFBF80]=0x82CFBFD0. This is the missing derived helper, not a reversal of combatConsumerSearch's bounded no-direct-read result.
loyaltyDefenseBoundary.predicate: 0x82CFBFD0..0x82CFBFE8 forms i=40*X+Y and compares U8[0x830E8790+i] with U8[U+0]. Mismatch skips. Match optionally calls0x82E6A3E0 at0x82CFC008 when presentation mode!=-1, then adds50 to r21 at0x82CFC00C. The helper returns accumulated r21 at0x82CFC09C. No local rank or movement write occurs.
loyaltyDefenseBoundary.combatJoin: Accepted ordinary unit-vs-unit resolver0x82CD9970 calls this with defender owner r25 and slot r30 at0x82CDAC10;0x82CDAC18 adds its result to the prior defender modifier r17 in r29. Rank-derived50 is added into r27 at0x82CDAD70/74. Under retained intervening state,0x82CDB39C multiplies effective defense r22 by that modifier r27 into r23. The selected Loyalty term is therefore additive50 percentage points to defense, not a flat+50 unit-stat write or an attack bonus. Other bonuses and later rules can change the total; no unconditional final1.5 multiplier is claimed.
loyaltyDefenseBoundary.attackSeparation: The adjacent attack helper0x82CFC0A8 switch maps index3 through U32[0x82CFC190]=0x82CFC380 (skip/loop), rather than its separate index2 Guerilla branch. Do not substitute Guerilla or Engineer for Loyalty.
loyaltyDefenseBoundary.homeTerritory: The stored description calls this home territory. The exact proved machine predicate is equality between the ordinary unit-owner byte and the coordinate-indexed territory-plane byte. Actual territory-plane publication/ownership semantics, supported readable coordinates and retention remain premises; the description is not proof of every territory writer.
loyaltyDefenseBoundary.conditions: Valid p/j/U/plane and bit/coordinate retention, normal required helper/presentation returns, finite strings, no destructive aliases and ordinary resolver-role retention through the selected joins. No new runtime, army, AI prediction or all-combat-mode parity observation.

presentation.qualification: The current Ghidra project does not connect the embedded GFx string family to a native read of unit +0x10. A full 0x54-byte unit copy at 0x82D81BA0 includes the field and feeds the presentation object path, but the exact upgrade-array reader is not yet proved.

persistence.sessionEntry: Accepted0x82D81560 ->0x82D81654 calls0x82CC4040(mode0,stream,alternate); load0x82D86400 ->0x82D86674 calls mode1. See resource-density-generation-boundary.json#/postSetupTileMutationBoundary/serialization for the wrapper and mode qualifications.
persistence.field: 0x82CC1DA0 captures mode in r27 and U in r31. The selected field address is U+0x10; mode1 calls0x822DE438 at0x82CC2048, mode0 calls0x822DE4A0 at0x82CC2064, and marker advances4. No Loyalty mask or rank conversion is applied to this32-bit transfer.
persistence.load: Default alternate=0:0x822DE438 ->0x822D93E8 at0x822DE488. The latter calls current stream+4 at0x822D9418 with count4 and destination U+0x10. If native-endian marker0x82F78854 differs from stream+8,0x822D9468..84 reverses bytes0/3 and1/2 in the destination; otherwise it retains their order.
persistence.save: Default alternate=0:0x822DE4A0 ->0x821D3EA0 at0x822DE4D8. The latter uses the source word directly or a reversed four-byte stack copy according to the same endian metadata, then calls current stream+8 at0x821D3F78 with count4. The selected local byte swap does not modify the live source word.
persistence.verdict: With completing four-byte stream operations, matching format/endian metadata, correct mode/default-alternate inputs and retained source/destination identity/lifetime, bit0x8 survives save/load with all other+0x10 bits. Whole save success, alternate-stream modes, later overwrite and actual round-trip execution remain unobserved. Loading this word is not a founding event and must not allocate the extra Militia.

currentEvidence.method: Foreground read-only Ghidra string, function, instruction, pointer, split-address, and field-access queries with narrow generated-code corroboration.
currentEvidence.qualification: Identity, storage, the normal grant behavior, Blitz's direct consumer, and Scout's downstream mode selection are statically strong. Other direct consumers and runtime behavior remain unproved.

guards: Do not model Veteran or Elite as special-upgrade bits; they use rank byte +0x05.
Keep unresolved native effect consumers and persistence boundaries explicit when exposing creation-time grants.
Do not claim that setting the March bit alone updates movement; the native grant command also changes +0x02.
Do not claim that setting Scout alone refreshes its UI; the native grant command explicitly invokes 0x82D11AD8.
Do not translate the Guerilla comparison into home or enemy territory ownership; attacker record +0x00 and the territory-table relation remain semantically unresolved.
Treat the Forest terrain hook as a proposed ordinary-combat rule boundary separate from the native Guerilla consumer, and preserve its displaced compares and resumes.
Do not call situational combat, healing, city-defense-stat display, +1 view, presentation, save/load, armies, or AI runtime-confirmed without a default-off probe.
conclusion: The supported image defines exactly nine special upgrades stored as bits zero through eight in runtime unit word +0x10. Command type 22 spends one Elite rank step and sets the selected bit. Blitz has an exact post-action movement consumer, March has an immediate movement side effect, Scout selects an exact downstream mode and triggers an immediate rebuild, and Guerilla has a statically proved attack-only territory comparison at 0x82CFC0A8. The ordinary-combat Forest evidence at 0x82CDB4E0 and 0x82CDB538 is a separate proposed hook boundary using participant coordinates and terrain byte 3; it does not establish Guerilla coupling or runtime behavior. The separate Loyalty branch now binds its defense-only+50 term under the exact owner/territory comparison, and default-stream serialization conditionally preserves the full upgrade word. Infiltration, Engineer, Leadership, Medic, exact presentation, territory semantics and runtime/alternate-stream behavior remain the active boundaries.
